notes.gateway.providers.wire.x_extract_json__m: This changes only spans[skipped][0] <= start to < start. A reasoning span begins at the opening < of a matched <think> tag; start is always an index returned by text.find("{"). The same string position cannot contain both < and {, so equality is impossible for every input. Thus the two comparisons produce the same branch, decoded object or error; candidate and timing budgets are unchanged. The other reasoning-span comparison at span END is not equivalent and was killed by the enforced deadline tests.
